items.t: Said the Supreme Court's Callais decision gives Alabama a framework to defend the legislature's 2021 and 2023 redistricting maps.
items.q: Now they have a framework for Alabama to directly defend what the legislature did both in 2021 and 2023,

items.t: Said the U.S. Constitution gives states the authority to set and enforce voter qualifications for all elections, including federal elections.
items.q: The United States Constitution is clear that the States set and enforce voter qualifications for all elections, including federal elections.

items.t: Said that when noncitizens vote, they dilute the voices of qualified citizens and undermine democracy.
items.q: When noncitizens vote, they dilute the voices of qualified citizens and undermine our democracy.

items.t: Said TikTok's safety features are a marketing ploy to trick parents into trusting a product TikTok knows is dangerous.
items.q: TikTok’s so-called ‘safety features’ are a joke. They are nothing more than a marketing ploy to trick parents into trusting a product that TikTok knows full well is dangerous.

items.q: Attorney General Steve Marshall has been appointed by Governor Kay Ivey to co-chair the newly-created Alabama Opioid Overdose and Addiction Council.

record.t: Launched the Initiative on Violent Crime.
record.q: In January 2018, Marshall launched the Initiative on Violent Crime with the mission to “help cities reclaim their streets, restore the rule of law, and . . . see their communities revived.”

record.t: Was appointed by Governor Kay Ivey to co-chair the Alabama Opioid Overdose and Addiction Council.
record.q: Attorney General Steve Marshall has been appointed by Governor Kay Ivey to co-chair the newly-created Alabama Opioid Overdose and Addiction Council.

record.t: Was sworn in as the forty-eighth Attorney General of Alabama.
record.q: Steve Marshall was sworn in as the forty-eighth Attorney General of the State of Alabama on February 10, 2017.

record.t: Served as District Attorney for Marshall County for sixteen years before becoming Attorney General.
record.q: Prior to taking office as Attorney General, Marshall was the District Attorney for Marshall County, a post he held for sixteen years.

record.t: Helped draft and pass the Brody Act, which makes it a crime to kill or injure an unborn child.
record.q: As District Attorney, Marshall helped draft and pass the Brody Act—a law that makes it a crime to kill or injure an unborn child.

record.t: Served as a member of the executive committee of the Republican Attorneys General Association.
record.q: Marshall serves as a member of the executive committee of the Republican Attorneys General Association

record.t: Announced that Alabama filed a lawsuit against TikTok Inc. and its parent company ByteDance Inc. in Montgomery County Circuit Court.
record.q: Alabama Attorney General Steve Marshall announced today that the State has filed a lawsuit against social media company TikTok Inc., and its parent company, ByteDance Inc., for exploiting children, addicting them to harmful content, and lying about the safety of its platform.

record.t: Announced a settlement with TikTok Inc.
record.q: Alabama Attorney General Steve Marshall announced today a landmark settlement with social media company TikTok Inc.

record.t: Announced a multi-state settlement with Meta that will bring $117 million to Alabama.
record.q: Last month, Attorney General Marshall announced a multi-state settlement with Meta that resolved similar claims that will bring $117 million to Alabama.

record.t: Announced a settlement with Roblox requiring stronger protections for children and securing $12 million in funding for School Resource Officers.
record.q: Attorney General Marshall previously announced a settlement with Roblox that requires stronger protections for children on the online gaming platform and secured $12 million in funding for School Resource Officers.

Attorney General Marshall has also recently announced an investigation into OpenAI seeking accountability and understanding of the vulnerabilities that permitted its AI model to hack another American AI company unprompted

record.t: Filed a 26-State brief in the U.S. Supreme Court in Republican National Committee v. Mi Familia Vota.
record.q: Alabama Attorney General Steve Marshall has filed a 26-State brief in the U.S. Supreme Court to defend election integrity and restore the States’ constitutional authority to set and enforce voter qualifications.

record.t: Led a letter from 13 Republican attorneys general backing the U.S. Postal Service's follow-up on a March 31 executive order on audits of state voter rolls.
record.q: Marshall led a letter in July from 13 Republican attorneys general, backing the U.S. Postal Service's following up on Trump's March 31 executive order that set up an audit of states' voter rolls
